exact_statement: Under A1-A2, P_hat_i is absolutely continuous with respect to P_star_i and KL(p_hat^{i+1} || q_i) <= KL(P_hat_i || P_star_i) = 0.5 * eps_hat_i^2.
quantifiers: Every generation i for which A1 and A2 hold.
pass_condition: The independent rule checker accepts the complete A1-A2 derivation with coefficient exactly 1/2 and rejects a coefficient-corrupted certificate. On five fresh confirmation seeds, neither endpoint estimator's one-sided 95% lower confidence bound may exceed the path-KL budget's one-sided 95% upper confidence bound, while both estimators must reject a deliberately false 0.1x path budget for every beta. The cumulative runner must exit zero.
failure_condition: Any proof dependency is missing, the exact coefficient changes, the certificate negative control passes, an endpoint estimator significantly contradicts the path budget at the one-sided 5% level, or either estimator fails to reject the false 0.1x budget.
verdict_rule: VERIFIED requires the proof certificate. The finite GMM experiment alone is only corroboration.
